title: micromeria fruticosa subsp. serpyllifolia
intro: Micromeria fruticosa subsp. serpyllifolia, commonly known as Rock Thyme or Mountain Thyme, is a subspecies of the Micromeria fruticosa plant, a type of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria fruticosa subsp. serpyllifolia include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
